// diagnostic

E2905

Performance budget `{name}` cannot resolve `{attachment}`

What

Performance budget `{name}` cannot resolve `{attachment}`

Why

The attachment has zero or multiple canonical matches.

Fix

Name one qualified scope, target, profile, or provider identity.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2905: tests/ui/perf_budget_e2905_unresolved.stderr.

Error [E2905]: performance budget ready cannot resolve scope
  --> tests/ui/perf_budget_e2905_unresolved.jet:4:9
    |
  4 |         scope: .Service("missing"),
    |         ^^^^^
 Why: no canonical Service attachment named `missing` exists in the containing package
 Fix: declare that attachment or use its canonical package-qualified identity
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E2905

Error [E0101]: this program has no `run` function
 Why: running a program starts at `fn run`, and the entry file doesn't define one
 Fix: add `fn run() { ... }` to the entry file
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0101
